fields.title: Sudan: Test situation report No. 2
fields.body-html:
Highlights

  • Families named shelter, water and food as their first needs.
  • Road access to the river crossing remains limited for heavy trucks.
  • Partners will hand the water points over to the site committees at the end of the month.

Temporary learning spaces opened in 11 sites for children who fled. Partners reached 4,814 people with water trucking in the river towns this week. The response plan is 47 per cent funded, according to the test tracking service. Temporary learning spaces opened in 9 sites for children who fled.
